authority: PI prospective ruling after completed D0
question: Is the spectacular Q_psi failure in own_flag_stolen states primarily an off-support/data-coverage problem, and how much is that localized failure depressing the otherwise optimization/interference-looking aggregate?

predecessor.note: own_flag_stolen was discovered from D0; D1B is therefore a postmortem follow-up diagnostic, not independent confirmation and not a new gate.

category_definitions.own_flag_home: own_flag_home == true (same boolean as D0 rows)
category_definitions.own_flag_stolen: own_flag_home == false (complement of own_flag_home; same as D0)

D1A.title: Phase-0 scorer support audit
D1A.purpose: Measure how much representation the Q_psi fitting data actually had of the four frozen categories, and compare those proportions to the frozen D0 z1|B trajectory distribution.

data.fitting_source: exact Phase 0 train data used to fit Q_psi

required_reports: seed-level uncertainty (seed-level bootstrap or seed-level means with CI)
comparison of Phase-0 fit proportions vs D0 z1|B trajectory proportions for the same four categories
explicitly_forbidden: using held-out Phase 0 seeds for support counts
D1A.permitted_interpretation: Whether the scorer was trained on very little of the state class where it later became confidently inverted. Descriptive coverage comparison only.

D1B.title: Pre-specified localization analysis on existing D0 rows
D1B.purpose: Test whether Q_psi's aggregate weakness is largely concentrated in flag-stolen states.

data.new_replay: FORBIDDEN -- reuse existing D0 rows only

procedure.quartile_rule: Within each bootstrap replicate, recompute the worst-quartile cutoff of margin_B_bits on the retained rows of that replicate (exactly as D0's within-sample quartile construction, but now per replicate after exclusion).
procedure.primary_analysis: Remove own_flag_stolen states; recompute worst-quartile Q_psi correct-rate with replicate-internal quartile cutoff; report point estimate and seed-level LCB95/UCB95.
procedure.complementary_stratum: Report the corresponding own_flag_home result (same bootstrap/quartile procedure on own_flag_home-only rows).

D1B.label: POSTMORTEM FOLLOW-UP DIAGNOSTIC -- not independent confirmation; not a new gate
D1B.why_postmortem: own_flag_stolen was discovered from inspecting D0 category breakdowns.

bootstrap_contract.rationale: Decision points are heavily clustered within episodes; effective sample size tracks seeds, not raw decision counts. Same clustering lesson that drove Gate 0B's seed-level bootstrap.

LOCALIZED_OFF_SUPPORT_PLUS_BROADER_INTER.when: Phase 0 barely contained flag-stolen states AND excluding them makes Q_psi look substantially stronger on the worst-quartile correct-rate
LOCALIZED_OFF_SUPPORT_PLUS_BROADER_INTER.favors: localized surrogate off-support + broader optimization interference

SCORER_REGIME_FAILURE.when: flag-stolen states were well represented in Phase 0 fit data but Q_psi is still confidently inverted there
SCORER_REGIME_FAILURE.favors: scorer target/capacity/representation failure in that game regime (not mere coverage)

DIFFUSE_INTERFERENCE.when: removing flag-stolen states barely changes the aggregate worst-quartile Q_psi correct-rate
DIFFUSE_INTERFERENCE.favors: interference problem more diffuse than D0 currently suggests

UNRESOLVED.when: seed-level uncertainty remains broad enough that the localization hypotheses cannot be separated

permitted_claims_after_D1: Evidence about whether own_flag_stolen failure is concentrated coverage vs regime failure vs diffuse interference
Descriptive Phase-0 vs D0 distribution comparisons with seed-level uncertainty
prohibited_claims_after_D1: SPPPO V1 would have passed under a different gate
Authorization of SPPPO V2 or any new training run
Any new scientific gate or threshold
successor_method_policy: Do not build the successor method until D1 completes. D1 can change its shape: sparse flag-stolen coverage may require targeted counterfactual data in those states; well-supported inversion argues against 'just collect more examples'; strong Q_psi outside the localized regime still leaves the separate optimization problem of attaching a mostly-correct strategic signal to z1.
